name: 高底盘四驱可坐越野电动车款

shots.intent: 极暗底衬托车体与越野轮组，在密集搜索结果里第一眼抓住点击。
shots.textZone: 顶部 25% 暗场留白承粗体中文主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一条 #D8232A 药丸标签内小字「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把家长最怕的托底刮蹭摆到台面上，先把顾虑变成一个可解决的问题。
shots.textZone: 画面上方 30% 留白承主标「{selling_point_1}」，底盘与地面之间用细引线连到一个 #D8232A 药丸标签「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 一屏讲清两种操控方式，让家长按孩子年龄自我匹配，降低选错成本。
shots.textZone: 左栏顶部主标「{selling_point_1}」，右栏顶部主标「{selling_point_2}」；两栏各一枚 #1A1A1C 实心圆形数字位徽章加一行细字标签

shots.intent: 给出真实使用规模与看护感，让家长直接代入周末院子的画面。
shots.textZone: 右上角 25% 干净留白承一行中文短标「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 用微距证明轮胎与轮毂是实打实的越野造型，而不是塑料薄壳贴图。
shots.textZone: 画面左侧 35% 留白，两行短标注「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」配 #1A1A1C 实心圆形数字位徽章

shots.intent: 呈现灯组、格栅与分色涂装的做工细节，把质感差异讲清楚。
shots.textZone: 画面右下 30% 留白承两行短标注：「{callout_1}」贴灯组、「{callout_2}」贴分色腰线

shots.intent: 把座椅、围栏与锁止结构可视化，把家长对乘坐安全的犹豫落地。
shots.textZone: 画面左栏 35% 竖排三行短标注：「{callout_1}」座椅、「{callout_2}」围栏、「{callout_3}」锁止，各配 #1A1A1C 实心圆形数字位徽章

shots.intent: 用同角度并排把可选项一次说清，方便买家直接下决定而不是退出比价。
shots.textZone: 画面底部 22% 留白，左右各一个 #D8232A 药丸标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，上方一枚 #1A1A1C 实心圆形数字位徽章对应每一款

shots.intent: 回到最干净的整车正面，用一句行动号召收束整套图，把犹豫推到点击。
shots.textZone: 顶部 28% 留白承主标「{selling_point_1}」，画面底部居中一枚 #D8232A 圆角按钮内白字行动号召「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #1A1A1C stage on hero and mechanism screens, alternating with a #F2EFE9 play mat carrying a #111213 and #FFFFFF checker border strip on floor screens; no other background materials
style.direction: bold off-road ride-on toy commerce, high-contrast dark stage alternating with an off-white race-track floor
style.iconSystem: solid #1A1A1C circular badges each holding one white numeral slot, uniform stroke-free fill, one badge per claim, never outlined and never multicolored
style.lightingSystem: single hard 5600K key from above and slightly front, short crisp contact shadows, tight shadow pooling under tires and chassis, grazing rim light separating glossy paint from matte trim
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: bold off-road ride-on toy commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #1A1A1C, #FFFFFF, #F2EFE9 and one accent #D8232A; neutral 5600K lighting with a hard short-shadow key from above; one ultra-bold geometric sans-serif; solid circular icon badges in #1A1A1C with white numeral slots; consistent play mat in #F2EFE9 with a #111213 and #FFFFFF checker border strip; stable product scale and placement; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no mixed fonts and no serif, handwritten, cartoon or retro lettering
no random backgrounds, no wood, marble, fabric or gradient studio backdrops
no lighting direction changes and no long soft shadows
no outlined, colored or mismatched icon styles
no brand name, wordmark, logo, watermark, store badge or QR code
no price, discount, coupon, shipping or after-sale time figure
no age grading, part count, dimension, weight, load, speed or runtime figure
no material grade, alloy or ABS callout, no certification or standard mark
no intelligence-boosting, focus-improving or skill-training efficacy claim
no child standing, running or playing on a lane, road or water edge
style.presentationRules: vehicle held at a stable scale on a fixed baseline in every screen, never cropped at the tires, all four wheels grounded with contact shadow, verticals stay vertical, one real scale-reference object present in every scene screen
style.surfaceSystem: matte #F2EFE9 play mat with fine visible grain and a #111213 and #FFFFFF checker border tape, low sheen, no mirror reflection, credible contact shadow at every tire
style.typography: one ultra-bold geometric Chinese sans-serif family, headline heavy and tight, #FFFFFF on the dark screens and #1A1A1C on the mat screens, short pill labels in #D8232A
